Duramin 40 is the primary range of Struers micro/microhardness testers. It is available with a manual and motorized XY-stage and with an overview camera. Duramin 40 comes with three load ranges; 10.0 gf – 10.0 kgf, 10.0 gf – 31.25 kgf, and 1.0 gf – 62.5 kgf. The tester includes an integrated PC with a separate monitor for touchscreen or mouse operation. Dual monitors are also an option. The test cycle is fully automatic, and a motorized six-position turret is standard. Add-on modules include Kc fracture measurements, mapping, and weld measurements.
